title: Big Pickle Now Frustrating to Use
summary: ### Description First noticed about 36 hours ago. I only use Big Pickle, and it's now getting to the point where it stops mid-thought as frequently as every two minutes or so, and I am having to constantly type "Keep going" at it over and over and over to get it to finish anything. It previously worked amazingly and could deep-dive into my code for 30+ minutes at a time. ### Plugins None? ### OpenCode version 1.17.20 ### Steps to reproduce 1. Ask Big Pickle a code question. 2. Wait a couple of minutes. 3. See it stop thinking entirely mid-sentence and sit at the prompt. ### Screenshot and/or share link _No response_ ### Operating System Xubuntu Noble, Linux 6.8.0 ### Terminal tmux
